title: ResourceArmor & Tools
description: Resource Armor & Tools - mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 (Forge)
body:
ResourceArmor & Tools
 Adds 49 new items: armor, tools, and magic items from 5 materials! \
🔴 Redstone - a balanced set \
💚 Emerald - superior to diamonds \
💙 Lazurite - excellent for enchanting \
🖤 Obsidian - walking on lavaAdds 49 new items: armor, tools, and magic items from 5 materials!

Magic items: \
🍎 Obsidian Apple - 11 level III effects \
🔥 Fire Bow - sets enemies on fire \
⚡ Thunder Bow - summons lightning \
🛡️ Reflective Shield - reflects arrows
